start: A member of the gym, number already confirmed, standing at the desk

steps.action: On the Gym tab tap 'Scan the poster' / 'Check in'
user_sees: Screen 'Scan the gym poster' with 'Point your camera at the QR code on the poster at your gym's desk.'
must_not: The photo camera app opening instead
A picture saved

steps.action: Point the camera at the poster
user_sees: Screen 'Gym check-in', 'Check in at <gym>' and 'Tap Check in when you are at the gym.'
must_not: A check-in made without a tap

steps.action: Tap 'Check in'
user_sees: 'Checking you in at <gym>…'
'You're checked in at 6:42 pm' and 'Checked in at <gym> as <first name>. Have a good workout.'
A button to start today's workout
must_not: Two visits for one day
A visit dated on the wrong day

start: A member; scans the poster with the phone's own camera app (link /c/CODE)

steps.action: Open the link the camera shows
user_sees: The app opens on 'Gym check-in' for that gym, with 'Check in'
must_not: The browser left on a web page with no way into the app

start: A member; first check-in, the app does not know the mobile number

steps.action: Tap 'Check in'
user_sees: 'Type the mobile number your gym has for you. The app asks only once.' and a box 'Your mobile number'
must_not: The number asked again on the next visit

steps.action: Type the number and tap 'Check in'
user_sees: 'First check-in: go to the front desk and ask them to confirm your mobile number. When they say it is done, tap Check in below. You do this only once.'
must_not: A check-in on a number the desk has not confirmed
Someone else's membership matched by a guessed number

start: A member; problems at the poster

steps.action: Scan a QR that is not a MettleUp poster
user_sees: 'Wrong QR code. Scan the MettleUp poster at your gym's desk.'
must_not: A web page or a payment opened

steps.action: Type 9 digits as the number
user_sees: 'That isn't a 10-digit mobile number. Check it and try again.'
must_not: The wrong number sent

steps.action: Scan another gym's poster
user_sees: 'You're not a member of <gym> in the app.' and 'Join this gym' / 'Not now'
must_not: A visit written at the other gym without a join

steps.action: Check in with no internet
user_sees: Plain words that the gym could not be reached, and 'Check in' to try again
must_not: 'You're checked in' shown when nothing was saved

start: A member; already checked in today

steps.action: Scan the poster again and tap 'Check in'
user_sees: 'You were already checked in at <gym> today. Nothing more to do.'
must_not: A second visit for today

steps.action: Check in when no plan covers today
user_sees: 'Your gym membership is not active today. Please see the desk.' under the check-in
must_not: The visit not recorded
A pass member told the membership is not active on every visit

steps.action: Look at what others can see
user_sees: Other members see only how busy the gym is
must_not: Other members seeing who came
The mobile number shown to other members
